name: Hover Dash (Misuzu)
summary: Turn a ground dash into an airborne approach.
description: Turn a ground dash into an airborne approach.

pages.title: Hover
pages.text: Misuzu's ground dash lifts her into the air. After the short rise, she can use an available air action: attack, jump, or air dash. Other hover-dash characters follow the same basic rule.

tasks.label: Hover forward, then attack from the hover
tasks.prompt: Dash with {input:66}. Once Misuzu floats up and can act, hit A, B, or C before you land.

feedback.success: Nice - that attack came straight out of the hover.
feedback.failure: Stay in the hover until Misuzu can act, then press an attack button before landing.

tasks.label: Hover forward, then use an air jump
tasks.prompt: Dash with {input:66}. Once you can act in the air, press a jump direction.

feedback.success: Nice - you spent the hover's air action on a jump.
feedback.failure: Do the jump while the hover is still active, not after landing.

tasks.label: Hover forward, then air dash
tasks.prompt: Dash with {input:66}. Once you can act in the air, go for {input:j.66} or {input:j.44}.

feedback.success: Nice - the air dash came straight out of the hover.
feedback.failure: Wait until Misuzu can act, then air dash before the hover ends.
